name: lazybrain
description: Search local Skill and tool metadata when the current Codex catalog does not resolve a lookup.

interface.longDescription: A local metadata search companion for Codex. Find source paths and compare overlapping Skills, Plugins, MCP configurations, agents, and commands. Native tool selection and task execution remain with Codex.
defaultPrompt: Find the local Skill source that fits this task.
Audit overlapping local capability entries and their sources.
